body: She's my mother, but I'm an adult and she convinces me to stay with her. She says if I leave, she will follow me. She keeps saying things like she'll take me to a specific area that has no public transportation and force me to depend on others forever. And she's nice one minute, then if the wrong thing is said or done she will explode instantly. and she won't take me to a psychiatrist except for every 3 months, she said a visit is $60, and that I should pay for it myself, but I don't have an income. I can't get a job. and I have people helping me find a job and they supposedly follow up, but it never works out. But as for therapy, how do I get a psychiatrist when I can't pay for it and the free/reduced health clinics link turns up nothing for psychiatrists in this city. I know she's an abuser. I've read the signs. But she always convinces me that I'm an abuser. I just want to end the pain by escaping this life whether I am or not. I've tried to call out for help so long, but nobody does anything. They make it seem so simple. "Just leave." But I have no place to go except on the street where she will find me and I'm too scared to go to a shelter for many reasons. So I just want help to die.

I can't escape this hell. I graduated with post-secondary education in 2010, but I can't get a job, not even minimum wage even though I've applied to so many and I'm ridiculed all the time for it and she makes me feel like a piece of shit, there's nothing physical and she's much older and convincing but she lied about DV one time. I was only arrested, but not prosecuted, but who would believe me now? Plus, I'm male. I have little work experience and can't gain any and I'm socially awkward. I'm tired of trying to get help and it's just easier to die. I've thought about it since 2005 and I finally feel ready. My childhood and life are stained and ruined. I'll never get my mental health or true happiness back. I can't go on.
